'''Mick Ptacek''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Parker tournament (18 November)]] on 18 November 2000 with Trooper swarm, according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1469">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-18-parker-co-11-18-00-back-in-actiond1469/ parker-co-11-18-00-back-in-action], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 18 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-18-parker-co-11-18-00-back-in-actiond1469/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
